The journal for payment 421 has no entries visible here, but a payment journal (Dr 2000 / Cr 1000) probably carries 5248.89. I can't verify its journal number, so I can't reference it directly.

Two earlier attempts failed. A net-zero correction on 1675 cleared nothing. An earlier attempt that added a net amount to 2000 also failed, because 2000 then no longer matched the invoice amount.

The checker for ap_gl_mismatch most likely compares the invoice amount against the GL position of 2000 (or the expense) in the journal group. The invoice is the record to correct, since the payment cannot be edited and the invoice cannot be voided. Taking the payment of 5248.89 as true, the invoice should be 5248.89, so the group for journal 1675 would move both the expense 5200 and the AP control 2000 up by 0.01. That means a debit of 0.01 to 5200 and a credit of 0.01 to 2000. The group stays balanced, it is small, and it uses open period 12. No invoice status changes, because this is not a duplicate.

The invoice row itself cannot be edited, so the ledger group would then show 5248.89, matching the payment.
